source_caption:
Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey has officially delivered one of the biggest openings of the year.

The film has earned $264.1 million worldwide in its opening weekend, making it the biggest global debut of Nolan’s career. For a nearly three-hour adaptation of Homer’s epic, it’s an incredible result and another reminder that audiences will still show up for ambitious, filmmaker-driven stories on the biggest screen possible.

The response has been just as impressive. The Odyssey currently holds a 97% critics’ score on Rotten Tomatoes, with praise directed toward Matt Damon’s performance as Odysseus, Hoyte van Hoytema’s breathtaking IMAX cinematography, Ludwig Göransson’s score, and the film’s sheer scale. Many critics are already calling it one of the cinematic events of the year.

Have you seen The Odyssey yet? What did you think?

source_details.synopsis: The Odyssey is a 2026 epic action fantasy film written and directed by Christopher Nolan, who produced it with his wife Emma Thomas. An adaptation of Homer's ancient Greek epic poem the Odyssey, it stars an ensemble cast including Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Lupita Nyong'o, Samantha Morton, Zendaya, and Charlize Theron. In the film, Odysseus (Damon), the Greek king of Ithaca, undergoes a long and perilous journey home after the Trojan War and encounters mythical beings as he attempts to reunite with his wife, Penelope (Hathaway).
